content_restrictions: Alcohol advertising must comply with state ABC board guidelines and cannot target minors
Health claims about menu items must not be misleading or unsubstantiated
Menu origin claims (e.g. 'authentic', 'traditional', 'imported') must be accurate and verifiable
Promotional pricing must include all applicable terms and not be deceptively advertised
prohibited_phrases: best Mexican food in the world
regulated_by: City or County Business License Authority
required_disclaimers: Health inspection grade must be visibly displayed on premises as required by local ordinance
Alcohol service requires valid state liquor license; service to minors strictly prohibited
Menu descriptions must accurately reflect ingredients and preparation methods per truth-in-menu regulations
ADA-compliant seating and restroom access required per Americans with Disabilities Act
